answer: Commit-reveal grading: each juror posts hash(score, salt) first, and reveals open only at the summit of the commit phase, after all five seats commit, so no seat can free-ride on a visible score during the voyage from commit to reveal. A seat that misses the 20 block reveal window forfeits 25% of its stake. Bypass: off-ledger coordination still works, because the hash hides scores but not side deals; the cheapest attack is a bribe above 25% of stake. Check rule: anyone recomputes hash(score, salt) for each revealed grade, rejects mismatches, and slashes any reveal after the pulse window.
